title: When I get home
goal: Say when something happens or happened with -AndA: öýe gelende, Aşgabada baranda.

intro.text: Add `-An` and `-dA` to a verb stem to say **when**: *gelende*, when (someone) comes; *baranda*, when (someone) gets there. The main verb at the end gives the tense: *Öýe gelende, çaý içýärin*, when I come home, I drink tea; *Öýe gelende, çaý içdim*, when I came home, I drank tea.

vocab.en: time (as in once, every time); turn

exercises.question: How do you say **when I come home**?

why.1: `-AndA` comes straight after the stem, with no past: *gel-* + *-ende*.
why.2: Coming **to** a place takes the dative: *öýe*.
why.3: No present either: `-AndA` goes on the bare stem, *gelende*.

exercises.en: When you go to school, take your book.

accept: anda

exercises.prompt: Call me when you get home.
accept: Öýe baranda, maňa jaň et.
Öýe baranda, maňa jaň ediň.
Öýe [baranyňda|gelende|geleniňde], maňa jaň [et|ediň].
Öýe [baranyňyzda|geleniňizde], maňa jaň ediň.
exercises.explain: *baranda*, when (you) get there; the imperative *jaň et* says who.

accept: When I came to Turkmenistan, it was winter.
It was winter when I came to Turkmenistan.
When I [arrived in|got to] Turkmenistan, it was winter.
It was winter when I [arrived in|got to] Turkmenistan.

exercises.question: *Ol gelende, men öýde däldim.* What does it mean?
options: When he came, I wasn't at home.
When I came, he wasn't at home.

why.2: *gelende* is **when (he) came**; the negative is on *däldim*.

exercises.explain: *Ol gelende*, when he came; *men öýde däldim*, I wasn't at home.

exercises.prompt: Every time I come home, I help my father.
accept: Her gezek öýe gelende, kakama kömek edýärin.
Her gezek öýe gelende, kakama kömek ederin.
Her gezek öýe gelenimde, kakama kömek [edýärin|ederin].
Men her gezek öýe [gelende|gelenimde], kakama kömek [edýärin|ederin].
Her gezek öýe [gelende|gelenimde], men kakama kömek [edýärin|ederin].
exercises.explain: *her gezek*, every time; *gelende*, when (I) come; *kömek etmek* takes the dative, *kakama*.

exercises.prompt: Sen gelmände, men saňa jaň etdim.
accept: When you did not come, I called you.
I called you when you did not come.
When you did not show up, I [called|phoned|rang] you.
When you did not come, I [phoned|rang] you.

exercises.prompt: When I went to the market, I forgot my money.
When the guests come, let's drink tea.
accept: Myhmanlar gelende, çaý içeli.
Myhmanlar gelende, çaý içeliň.
exercises.explain: *Myhmanlar gelende*, when the guests come; *içeli*, let's drink.

exercises.prompt: Aşgabada baranda, Magtymguly köçesindäki muzeýi gördüm.
accept: When I went to Ashgabat, I saw the museum on Magtymguly Street.
When I [got to|came to|was in|visited] Ashgabat, I saw the museum on Magtymguly Street.
I saw the museum on Magtymguly Street when I [went to|got to|came to|was in|visited] Ashgabat.
